original_question: Is the space BΓn is n + 1-connected?
target_in_paper: Section 9.2, Question 9.8: the higher-dimensional PL Haefliger-space connectivity question asking whether BΓ_n^{PL} is (n+1)-connected. ([conferences.cirm-math.fr](https://conferences.cirm-math.fr/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/Problem_list_3082.pdf))
correct_elements: Your draft correctly identifies that the paper asks a connectivity question with threshold n + 1, and that the object is a Haefliger classifying space from the homotopy-theory-of-foliations discussion. The only official formulation in the paper with exactly this n + 1 connectivity threshold is Question 9.8. ([conferences.cirm-math.fr](https://conferences.cirm-math.fr/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/Problem_list_3082.pdf))
missing_details: The paper’s space is BΓ_n^{PL}, not BΓ_n; the PL superscript is essential. Without it, the draft can be confused with the smooth spaces BΓ_q or B\bar{Γ}_q discussed in Section 9.1. ([conferences.cirm-math.fr](https://conferences.cirm-math.fr/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/Problem_list_3082.pdf))

BΓ_n^{PL} should be identified explicitly as the classifying space of codimension-n piecewise-linear Haefliger structures; this is stated for n = 2 in Theorem 9.6 and is the immediate context for Question 9.8. ([conferences.cirm-math.fr](https://conferences.cirm-math.fr/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/Problem_list_3082.pdf))

The variable n is the codimension parameter. The surrounding sentence says the author wants to generalize the codimension-2 result to higher dimensions, so that role of n should be made explicit. ([conferences.cirm-math.fr](https://conferences.cirm-math.fr/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/Problem_list_3082.pdf))

The codimension-2 case is already known: Theorem 9.6 proves that BΓ_2^{PL} is 4-connected. So the genuinely open content is the general higher-dimensional analogue, not the n = 2 case. ([conferences.cirm-math.fr](https://conferences.cirm-math.fr/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/Problem_list_3082.pdf))

If left as BΓ_n rather than BΓ_n^{PL}, the draft drifts toward a different nearby problem: Question 9.1 asks whether B\bar{Γ}_q is 2q-connected in the smooth trivial-normal-bundle setting, not whether a PL space is (n+1)-connected. ([conferences.cirm-math.fr](https://conferences.cirm-math.fr/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/Problem_list_3082.pdf))
refined_question: Let BΓ_n^{PL} denote the classifying space of codimension-n piecewise-linear Haefliger structures. Is BΓ_n^{PL} (n+1)-connected? ([conferences.cirm-math.fr](https://conferences.cirm-math.fr/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/Problem_list_3082.pdf))
justification: The draft matches Question 9.8 almost verbatim once the missing PL superscript is restored: Question 9.8 on page 33 asks whether BΓ_n^{PL} is n + 1-connected. Theorem 9.6 immediately before it identifies BΓ_2^{PL} as the classifying space of codimension-2 PL Haefliger structures and proves the n = 2 case, showing that the intended problem is the higher-dimensional PL analogue. This is distinct from Question 9.1 in Section 9.1, which concerns the smooth trivial-normal-bundle space B\bar{Γ}_q and asks for 2q-connectivity, not n + 1 connectivity. ([conferences.cirm-math.fr](https://conferences.cirm-math.fr/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/Problem_list_3082.pdf))

citations.label: Definition of Γ_q-structure, BΓ_q, and B\bar{Γ}_q
